blocks.text: Cloud storage mein users apna data apne device ki bajaye door ke (remote) servers par save karte hain. Is se data kahin se bhi khola aur doosron ke saath share kiya ja sakta hai.

Misal (Example): Google Drive aur Dropbox jaisi services cloud storage deti hain jin mein users files online rakh aur share kar sakte hain. Karobar apne data ka backup cloud storage mein rakhte hain, taake apne hardware ke kharab hone ya kisi aur masle ki soorat mein data mehfooz rahe.

blocks.prompt: Cloud backup usi computer par rakhe backup se zyada mehfooz kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Agar computer gum, chori ya kharab ho jaye to us par rakha backup bhi chala jata hai, jabke cloud wali copy door ke servers par mehfooz rehti hai.

items: Cloud storage: data door ke servers par; kahin se bhi rasai aur sharing (Google Drive, Dropbox).
Backups local hardware kharab hone se mehfooz.
